semiconductor_relevance: High — Applied Nano Technology Science, Inc. provides specialized equipment and services that are critical for vacuum and nanotechnology applications in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Applied Nano Technology Science, Inc. (ANTS) specializes in manufacturing high-precision equipment for vacuum applications, including magnetic rotating feeders and contact angle analyzers. Their products are widely utilized in the electronics sector, particularly in semiconductor and nanotechnology development, ensuring reliability and customization for customer needs.
capabilities: Direct liquid injection vaporizers and atomizers

regional_presence.Taiwan: ANTS launched Taiwan's first magnetic rotating feeder in 2003 and has established a strong presence in the region.
